description: Model Usage Over Time chart cleanup, client-side only (API unchanged). Show the top-N models by total tokens (input+output) in the selected range: default 8, a Top 5/8/12/All control persisted in localStorage under pref:analytics:modelUsageTopN, and the rest summed into one 'Other' series. Exclude non-inference rows: connection-test, model-sync, health probes, embeddings, and zero totals. Render a compact wrapping legend with truncated labels plus a full-name title, and colors that stay stable per model. No alias collapsing, because no suitable canonical model-id helper exists (plan.md Decision 3). Independent of FEAT-002. Full rationale: plan.md Decisions 1-8.
steps: Create src/shared/components/analytics/modelUsageSeries.ts as a pure module (no React, no recharts; it may import MODEL_COLORS from @/shared/constants/colors). Exports: MODEL_USAGE_TOP_N_OPTIONS = [5, 8, 12, 'all'] as const; type ModelUsageTopN; DEFAULT_MODEL_USAGE_TOP_N = 8; MODEL_USAGE_TOP_N_STORAGE_KEY = 'pref:analytics:modelUsageTopN'; OTHER_SERIES_KEY = '__other__'; OTHER_SERIES_COLOR = '#94A3B8'; parseModelUsageTopN(raw), where invalid or missing gives 8; isNonInferenceModel(id), case-insensitive: exact 'connection-test' or 'model-sync', /(^|[-_.:/])health[-_]?(check|probe)s?($|[-_.:/])/i, or /embed/i; assignStableModelColors(keysInRankOrder), which hashes each key with FNV-1a 32-bit to a preferred MODEL_COLORS slot and linear-probes past used slots in rank order, so there are no duplicates for 15 or fewer keys; buildModelUsageSeries(dailyByModel, modelNames, topN) returning { rows, series: [{ key, name, total, color, isOther }], hiddenModelCount }. Inside buildModelUsageSeries: candidate keys are modelNames ∪ row keys minus date/dateLabel; non-finite values count as 0; drop excluded and zero-total keys; sort by total descending, ties by id ascending; visible = first N (all for 'all'); __other__ per row = sum of the hidden non-excluded keys, emitted only if its total is greater than 0; rows keep date, dateLabel 'MM/DD' (split on '-', as the current chart does), and the visible keys only.

Create tests/unit/shared/model-usage-series.test.ts (node:test + node:assert/strict). Cover: top-N ranks by range total, not by a single day; Other's per-row and total sums equal the hidden models; connection-test, model-sync, health-check, healthprobe, and *embed* ids are absent from both the series and Other; zero and NaN/undefined values are dropped; shuffled modelNames give identical output, including ties; 'all' has no Other; no Other when the hidden totals are 0; parseModelUsageTopN handles '5', '8', '12', 'all', garbage, and null; assignStableModelColors is deterministic, has no duplicates up to 15 keys, and keeps a model's color when an unrelated model is added or removed where its slot is free.

Rewire ModelOverTimeChart and ModelOverTimeChartBody in src/shared/components/analytics/rechartsUsageCharts.tsx. Add topN state in ModelOverTimeChart with a lazy initializer: return the default when globalThis.window === undefined, otherwise try parseModelUsageTopN(localStorage.getItem(KEY)) inside catch. Add a setter that writes String(next) to localStorage inside try/catch. Compute useMemo(buildModelUsageSeries(...)). Use the empty state (chartNoData) when there are no rows or no series. Render one Area per series with dataKey = s.key, name = isOther ? t('chartOther') : s.name, and stroke/fill = s.color; keep stackId '1' and the existing axes and DarkTooltip. In the header row, render the title on the left and on the right a small button group (role='group', aria-label = t('chartTopNLabel'); each button is type='button' with aria-pressed and labeled t('chartTopN', { count }) or t('chartTopAll'); use compact text-[10px] styling consistent with the card). Legend: a single 'flex flex-wrap items-center gap-x-3 gap-y-1' row over the series only. Each item is a span with 'flex items-center gap-1 max-w-[12rem] min-w-0', a color dot, and a label span with className 'truncate' and title = full name. Do NOT import recharts and do NOT change DailyTrendChart or the props UsageAnalytics.tsx passes.

Add keys to the analytics object in src/i18n/messages/en.json next to chartModelUsageOverTime: chartOther 'Other', chartTopN 'Top {count}', chartTopAll 'All', chartTopNLabel 'Models shown'. Run `npm run i18n:sync-ui` from the repo to backfill the other 66 locales with __MISSING__ markers, then commit them.

Create tests/unit/ui/model-over-time-chart.test.tsx (Vitest, // @vitest-environment jsdom). Mock next-intl as tests/unit/ui/analytics-token-hover-tooltip.test.tsx does: t returns the key, or key:JSON(values) when values are passed. vi.mock('@/shared/components/analytics/rechartsCore') to export useRecharts: () => a stub where ResponsiveContainer and AreaChart render their children in a div, Area renders <span data-testid='area' data-key={dataKey} />, and XAxis, YAxis, and Tooltip render null; also export ChartLoadingCard and DarkTooltip stubs. Clear localStorage in beforeEach. Assert: with 12 nonzero models plus connection-test and codestral-embed carrying tokens, the default view has 8 areas + '__other__'; the legend has 9 items, each with a title; connection-test and codestral-embed text are absent; clicking the 'Top 5' button (aria-pressed toggles) gives 5 + Other and localStorage holds '5'; a pre-seeded 'all' gives 12 areas and no Other; all-zero input renders 'chartNoData'.
Run the verification commands below, fix any findings, then commit locally: `git add <specific files>` and `git commit -m 'feat(analytics): top-N model usage chart with compact legend'`. Do not push.
acceptance_criteria: Default chart shows at most 8 model series + Other; connection-test, model-sync, health probes, embed ids and zero-token models never appear in series, legend or Other
Top-N choice persists across reloads via localStorage key pref:analytics:modelUsageTopN
Legend labels truncate with ellipsis and expose full name via title; colors per model are derived from a hash of the id, not list index
